Immediate sample raw winner player1 normalizes to P0 WIN; delayed sample raw winner player2 normalizes to P0 LOSS. Comparison preparation is explicit and human outcomes remain 0.

Six profile-by-rate groups each report 12 planned seeds, 0 censored, completion and P0-perspective matchup rates, decision opportunities, native attempts, P0 mana spent, and P1 decision counts. I checked all 144 records: each includes both actors, no browser errors, and each terminal winner mapped to P0 agrees with the raw winner.
